system.description:
DISCIPLE MYSTIC STANCE

Prerequisites Devoted or Primal Monastic Path

You assume the graceful Crane Stance, mimicking a crane's elegant wingspan while executing fluid and defensive movements. You gain a +2-circumstance bonus to DB.

While in Crane Stance, you reduce the difficulty for High Jump and Long Jump (Athletics) checks by 5.

Automated: press Use to enter the stance: 1 AP, under the system's stance rules (one stance at a time, or two with Stance Mastery; Reactive Stance enters it free at initiative). It lasts until you enter another stance or delete its effect. While in it: +2 circumstance to your DB, and +5 to High Jump and Long Jump checks (the book's "reduce the difficulty by 5", as a bonus of the same size). The Path is checked when you enter it.
